orders.text:
I.A. No. 3629/2018 (Urgency Application)
In 
CRLR No. 104 of 2018
Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
Dr. Kartikey Hari Gupta, Advocate 
for the revisionist. 
Mr. Pankaj Joshi, Brief Holder for 
the State of Uttarakhand. 
Mr. Dharmesh Kumar, Advocate, 
holding brief of Mr. Deep Chandra 
Joshi, Advocate for respondent nos. 2, 3 
& 4. 
Heard learned counsel for the 
parties. 
Parties are amenable for an 
attempt at mediation. 
List this matter on 24.05.2018. 
Parties to appear on 24.05.2018. 
Noting their presence, they will be 
referred for mediation on the same day. 
Urgency application is, 
accordingly, disposed of. 
 (V.K. Bist, J.) 
Arpan 16.05.2018

Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
Dr. Kartikey Hari Gupta, 
Advocate for the revisionist. 
Mr. P.S. Bohara, A.G.A. along 
with Mr. Siddhartha Bisht, Brief 
Holder for the State of Uttarakhand. 
Mr. Deep Chandra Joshi, 
Advocate for respondent nos.2 to 4. 
Heard. 
Mr. Durgesh Mohan Sharma 
(husband/revisionist) and Mrs. 
Poonam Sharma (respondent 
no.2/wife) are present before the 
Court. 
Mr. Duresh Mohan Sharma, 
undertakes that he will withdraw the 
FIR registered against his wife and 
her family member under Section 390 
of IPC. 
List this matter on 30.5.2018. 
Parties to appear on 30.5.2018. 
Noting their presence, they will be 
referred for mediation on the same 
day.
